## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and the expected behavior.

## Affected entry point

Which contract entry point, script, or client flow is affected? See [docs/CONTRACT.md](../../docs/CONTRACT.md).

## Reproduction

List the network, commit, inputs, and smallest reproduction you can share.

## Logs or transaction details

Include sanitized logs, transaction hash, or test output. Never include secrets.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] I can reproduce this on the latest `fresh-build` branch.
